paper.title_en: Gravitational Mode Instabilities in Kerr-like Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We identify exponentially growing modes of a homogeneous gravitational Teukolsky-like operator on highly spinning Kerr-like black holes subject to quasinormal mode boundary conditions. Specifically, we compute electromagnetic and gravitational quasinormal modes of a spacetime proposed by Konoplya, Rezzolla, and Zhidenko that parametrizes deformations from the Kerr geometry, including configurations with black hole spin parameter $a/M > 1$ that retain an event horizon. Using the continued fraction method, we find that the spin-weight $s=-2$ operator develops exponentially growing modes when the black hole spin and deformation parameters are sufficiently large, while the electromagnetic modes remain damped throughout the parameter space. We further compare the quasinormal mode predictions with an agnostic analysis of the GW250114 ringdown, identifying regions of the parameter space that are compatible with the spectrum inferred from the data.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 研究高度自旋Kerr-like黑洞上Teukolsky型算符的准正规模不稳定性，涉及超越Kerr的度规参数化变形与事件视界存在时的a/M>1情形，并利用连分式方法计算电磁与引力模式，属于引力度规基础与修改引力交叉的理论课题，方法细节充分，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 类Kerr黑洞中的引力模式不稳定性
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在具有准正规模边界条件的高自旋类Kerr黑洞上，识别出齐次类Teukolsky引力算符的指数增长模式。具体而言，我们计算了Konoplya、Rezzolla和Zhidenko提出的一种时空的电磁与引力准正规模，该时空参数化了对Kerr几何的偏离，包括保持事件视界的黑洞自旋参数 $a/M > 1$ 的位形。使用连分式方法，我们发现当黑洞自旋与变形参数足够大时，自旋权重 $s=-2$ 的算符会产生指数增长模式，而电磁模式在整个参数空间中保持阻尼。我们进一步将准正规模预言与对GW250114铃宕的无先验分析进行比较，识别出与数据推断出的频谱相容的参数空间区域。
